description: Defines interval types and conversion functions for Resource Blocks (CRB, PRB, VRB) in a 5G NR context, including interval manipulations and conversions based on BWP limits.

methods.name: crb_to_prb
methods.description: Converts a CRB index to a PRB index within given BWP limits.

methods.name: crb_to_prb
methods.description: Converts a CRB interval to a PRB interval within given BWP limits.

methods.name: prb_to_crb
methods.description: Converts a PRB index to a CRB index within given BWP limits.

methods.name: prb_to_crb
methods.description: Converts a PRB interval to a CRB interval within given BWP limits.

methods.name: crb_to_vrb_f1_0_common_ss_non_interleaved
methods.description: Converts a CRB interval to a VRB interval for a common search space as per TS38.211.
